I've worked on projects involving Mars terrain navigation, satellite-based wildfire monitoring, hurricane prediction, and compute-efficient deep learning. My experience includes Python, PyTorch, image segmentation, object detection, and model optimization.
summary:
Decades of microgravity combustion experiments live in NASA's Physical Science Informatics (PSI) database, yet zero partial-gravity fire data exists for Lunar (0.16g) or Martian (0.38g) habitats, where elevated oxygen (30-34% O2 at 10.2 psi) sharply increases fire risk.

We built PyroSense-SI, an interactive Super-Intelligence dashboard powered by a 16-investigation NASA PSI knowledge engine and three GPU-trained PyTorch models:
1. Residual Flammability PINN (R2 = 0.9959) with Monte Carlo Dropout 95% uncertainty bounds predicting flame spread and Limiting Oxygen Index from 0g to 1g.
2. 2D Navier-Stokes + Arrhenius PINN (10,000 epochs) rendering live flame temperature fields across ISS, Lunar, and Mars regimes.
3. FlameUNet (0.9849 mIoU on 3,600 real NASA flame frames) segmenting soot cores from reaction zones.

PyroSense-SI also ranks 16 NASA studies by thermodynamic proximity, provides a citation-grounded AI copilot, compares ISS hardware racks, and distinguishes pyrolysis smoke from lunar regolith dust to prevent false alarms in future Artemis bases, pressurized rovers, and terrestrial fire modeling.
details:
What It Does & How It Works

PyroSense-SI is an interactive Super-Intelligence (SI) and Physics-Informed AI dashboard that turns NASA's Physical Science Informatics (PSI) microgravity combustion archive into actionable fire-safety intelligence for Moon, Mars, and Earth habitats.

Because zero partial-gravity (0.16g Lunar, 0.38g Mars) combustion experiments exist in NASA PSI, PyroSense-SI bridges the gap through four integrated modules:

  • Predict (1D Residual PINN + 2D Navier-Stokes PINN): A 128-dim Residual Physics-Informed Neural Network (R2 = 0.9959) with Monte Carlo Dropout 95% confidence bounds predicts flame spread rate, Limiting Oxygen Index (LOI), peak temperature, and radiative fraction across custom O2%, pressure, gravity (0g to 1g), airflow, and electric-field (E-FIELD) conditions. Simultaneously, a 10,000-epoch 2D Navier-Stokes + Arrhenius + Radiation PINN (PDE residual = 0.015) renders live temperature, plume velocity, and oxygen-depletion fields across ISS, Lunar, Mars, and Earth regimes.
  • Ranker & Grounded Copilot: Indexes 16 NASA PSI investigations (BASS, BASS-II, Saffire I-III, ACME BRE/CFI-G/E-FIELD/SLICE, FLEX/FLEX-2/CFI, SAME/SAME-R, DAFT/DAFT-2) and ranks them by thermodynamic proximity to the user's target habitat. Includes an interactive O2-vs-Pressure envelope map, tested range meters, and a citation-grounded AI copilot tailored to aerospace engineers, researchers, and students.
  • Vision (FlameUNet): A PyTorch U-Net encoder-decoder trained on 3,600 real NASA microgravity flame frames (Val mIoU = 0.9849, CE loss = 0.0177) that segments blue reaction zones, hot soot cores, and background morphology in real time.
  • Diff & Smoke/Dust Classifier: Compares ISS experimental racks (CIR/MDCA, MSG/SPICE Flow Duct, Cygnus Saffire) side by side and models Mie-scattering aerosol distributions (1.15 um cutoff) based on SAME and DAFT-2 lineage to separate pyrolysis smoke from lunar/Martian regolith dust.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Spaceflight Crew Safety: Helps mission planners evaluate fire hazards inside Artemis Lunar bases and pressurized rovers (30-34% O2 at 10.2 psi), spacesuit pre-breathe environments, and Mars transit cabins without waiting years for partial-gravity flight data.
  • False-Alarm Prevention: Distinguishes fine wire-insulation smoke (Kapton, PTFE) from suspended lunar/Martian regolith dust to prevent false smoke-detector alerts.
  • Terrestrial Impact: Supports predictive material-flammability modeling, low-flow ventilation fire analysis, and next-generation multi-channel smoke/aerosol detection on Earth.

Tools, Languages, Hardware & Software Used

  • AI / Physics Modeling: Python, PyTorch (GPU-trained on Google Colab CUDA), Residual PINN, 2D Navier-Stokes PDE PINN, FlameUNet, NumPy, SciPy.
  • Backend & API: FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic.
  • Frontend & Visualization: React, TypeScript/JavaScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Lucide Icons, custom 3D microgravity flame hero animation.
  • Deployment & Testing: Docker, Netlify (frontend), Render (backend API), Playwright & Pytest.

Creativity & Design Factors Considered

  • Physics-Constrained Extrapolation: Rather than using pure black-box regression that fails outside 0g/1g training data, we enforced Navier-Stokes, Arrhenius kinetics, radiative heat loss, and E-FIELD ion-body-force physics directly in the neural network loss functions and bounded predictions with 95% uncertainty intervals.
  • Zero-Hallucination Grounding: Zero-Hallucination Grounding: Every ranker score, range meter, and copilot explanation cites verified NASA PSI study metadata and hardware racks rather than inventing unverified numbers. PyroSense-SI clearly separates verified NASA PSI experimental envelopes (shown via Ranker range meters) from Physics-Informed Neural Network partial-gravity extrapolations (bounded by 95% Monte Carlo Dropout confidence intervals).
  • Multi-Audience Accessibility: Built presets for ISS, Lunar Base (34% O2), Mars Habitat (30% O2), and Spacesuit (100% O2), plus role-adapted explanations for engineers, researchers, and students.
